caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a cup and saucer set. The cup is shown from two perspectives: a top-down view and a side view. The cup is light cream or beige in color and features a ribbed or fluted band around the upper part. There is a handle on the right side, colored brown with some shading for depth. The body of the cup is decorated with a botanical design, showing green serrated leaves and clusters of dark red or purple berries. The saucer underneath is similarly light in color, with delicate grooves radiating outward from the center. The top-down view of the cup, shown above the full set, highlights the interior with a light beige base and a section with a different, darker interior tone. The background is off-white or light cream and unadorned, placing full focus on the cup and saucer.
title: Mustache Cup and Saucer
